claims.claim: The installed folder matches the metadata name; SKILL.md has nonempty name and description; extra resources are optional and loaded selectively.

scope.specification: Agent Skills format; host-specific discovery remains separately testable

claims.review_trigger: Agent Skills format or target-host loading behavior changes

claims.claim: Use a concise routing entry point and load detailed resources for the current decision; file-size reduction alone is not proof of reduced observed token use.

scope.design: Project authoring policy informed by published skill guidance

claims.review_trigger: Observed task traces show missed resources, redundant reads, or higher cost without quality benefit

claims.claim: Assess task outcomes, artifacts, process constraints, usability, and efficiency separately; deterministic integrity checks do not demonstrate comparative agent-quality gains.

scope.evaluation: Development fixtures and future paired A/B/C runs

claims.review_trigger: Model, host, tools, permissions, grader, or supported task population changes
